In a world where demons and humans coexist, the elite members of the organization [Demon-Slaying Warriors], which stands against the demon threat, face a family crisis! 

S-rank Demon-Slaying Warriors Mizuki, Cecilia, and Rekka learn that Mizuki's daughter Akari has failed her infiltration mission and been captured. To rescue Akari, the three infiltrate the demons' lair, but they are discovered by the enemy. 

Cecilia and Rekka get caught in the demons' schemes, while Mizuki ventures alone into the [Breeding Dungeon] where her daughter is held. 

The harsh trials awaiting her shake Mizuki's heart and bonds... Resist and protect to the end—the epic battle to save her beloved family begins now! 

Will Mizuki and the others successfully rescue Akari? Witness the touching conclusion together.

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] High-Frequency Event System: New developments unfold every time you explore the Breeding Dungeon! A stress-free, smooth progression design.

[*] Voice & Animation: Lively character expressions and voice acting deliver maximum immersion.

notes.title: "BLACK SOULS II" will be released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/3d2f7bab3911e08e53ebe7910d1121bae0e46be1.png[/img]
[url=https://discord.gg/yW54Vr6Q8Q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/8a59d8b4fd12eafc86d6ac97c71a88434692c635.png[/img][/url]

"BLACK SOULS II" will be released!
Don't forget to add this game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3855540
[h2]GAME[/h2]
Despair. Fear, Madness, once again.
An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass."
Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".

[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
●Introduction
In this work, you'll meet 45 Heroines.
Almost all of them are the fun characters you may have met before in the famous tale "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland".
Though, now all of them are charming girls.
(However, the most important for you is Alice, of course, isn't that right?)
・The White Rabbit
・The Cheshire Cat
・The Hatter
・The March Hare
・The Dormouse
・The Duchess
・The Mock Turtle
・The Gryphon
・The Queen of Hearts
・The Red Queen

And many others...

●SEN System
All NPCs in this world can be killed. However, should you do so, your SEN would decrease. And as it gets too low:
・BGM will disappear.
・All the inhabitants will begin to talk in an incomprehensible language.
・Some things that should not be seen will become visible.
What a frightening ailment it is!

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] A vast, open world made of many different and charming maps.
[*] Will you kill or will you be killed? Tactical and tense ATB combat.
[*] Explore the Wonderland end to end, gathering souls and raising your level.
[*] Death is not the end, merely a setback as you resume from the last bonfire.
[*] Many different endings
[/list]

notes.title: Farming Simulation Game "World Tree Ranch: Elven Legacy" will be released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/0344582bb8f9eec29fcad6dea19ab9465654983d.png[/img]
[url=https://discord.gg/yW54Vr6Q8Q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38391122/8a59d8b4fd12eafc86d6ac97c71a88434692c635.png[/img][/url]

Farming Simulation Game "World Tree Ranch: Elven Legacy" will be released!
Don't forget to add this game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3586450

[h2]GAME[/h2]
You awaken with no memories in a tranquil elven village devoted to worshipping the World Tree.
All the elves living here are women, and they have a unique request—they ask for your help in having children...
Embrace a leisurely slow life filled with relaxation, and enjoy your days freely bonding with the charming and distinctive elven girls!

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[h3]Relaxing Slow-Life Activities[/h3]
Engage in farming: grow a variety of crops and care for livestock to fully experience ranch life.
Experience seasonal changes in the village: enjoy gathering items, bug-catching, and fishing, along with special seasonal events.
Develop and expand the village as you progress, unlocking new features and expanding your home.

[h3]Build Relationships[/h3]
Chat with the elven girls, gift them items, and strengthen your bonds.
Deepen your connections and unlock marriage possibilities—aim to build your dream harem by marrying every girl!

[h3]Dress-Up and Customization[/h3]
Change the girls' outfits at any time, customizing colors to your preference.
Explore a wide range of outfits, including everyday wear, uniforms, and fun cosplay costumes.

[h3]Extra Content and Mini-Games[/h3]
Participate in exciting horse races with horses you've personally raised. Train your horse to become a champion in prestigious G1 races!
Take on diverse challenges to earn trophies, and proudly display your achievements in your trophy room.

Dive into this delightful world of relaxation, romance, and endless possibilities!

★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★
